hero.tagline: Your photo library, described and searchable by AI — private by default, and fully under your control.

about.title: About
about.f1_desc: Every photo gets a natural-language description from a vision model.
about.f2_desc: Finds and indexes text that appears inside your photos.
about.f3_desc: Search your library by meaning, not just filenames or tags.
about.f4_desc: Finds exact and near-duplicate photos automatically.
about.f5_desc: Descriptions, tags, and search all run on your machine out of the box — your photos never leave your computer unless you explicitly choose otherwise.
about.f6_desc: Every AI capability (descriptions, tagging, search, translation, chat) can be switched independently between a local model and a remote provider you configure yourself (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and more) — you decide where your data goes.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.step1_desc: Download the file for your platform above, then open it. On macOS, if you see a warning that the app is from an unidentified developer, right-click the app and choose Open.
gettingStarted.step2_desc: On first launch, the Setup Wizard walks you through choosing which AI models to install. You can skip optional models and download them later from Settings.
gettingStarted.step3_desc: Open Settings to set your language and default photo folder. Open Models to choose which AI capabilities are active — descriptions, tagging, search, translation, and OCR.
gettingStarted.step4_title: 4. Add your photos: Watcher or Scan
gettingStarted.step4_desc: On the Folders page, add a Watcher to automatically process new photos as they arrive in a folder (ideal for syncing from your phone), or run a one-time Scan to process an existing folder of photos.
gettingStarted.step5_desc: Track progress on the Processing page, then browse your described, searchable library in the Gallery.
